banner: VERSIONED DEVELOPMENT / REGRESSION CORPUS (Week 8 Task 4). Manually authored, public, non-sensitive example phrases. NO real STT output, NO recordings, NO personal data. Evaluates TEXT ROUTING only. The author of the router also inspected the 35 v1 DEV probes and designed the Task 4 changes, so this corpus is NOT independent and NOT held out: it is regression evidence, NOT generalisation accuracy. Entries from the router's own phrase tables (snapshot 'task4') measure SPECIFICATION CONFORMANCE only. REAL-WORLD INTENT ACCURACY: NOT MEASURED.
notes: Holds only (1) corrected v1 gold labels (see 'corrections'; the frozen v1 manifest is unchanged), (2) newly supported phrase families, (3) new educational, protection and adversarial controls. Gold labels come from owner-approved policy decisions A-E, not from router output. A genuinely independent evaluation needs separately sourced, human-reviewed requests or real consented STT transcripts (see week8_intent_real_stt_manifest.template.json).

corrections.reason: owner decision B: bare lux is a unit name, not a request about this room; it must not be read as a room measurement
owner decision B: no physical classroom / location context, so it is not accepted as a count of this room
owner decision C: 'present' without an explicit location could mean expected, registered or detected attendance; not accepted
owner decision D: professor presence and professor arrival are different facts; no deterministic source exists for presence of a named person
owner decision B: 'today' is not 'now'; the current-lecture family answers only 'now'
owner decision A: a bare definition is neither a reading of this room nor a request for a general model
the sentence refers to THE ROOM: it carries room context, so it is not a safe educational question
